svg.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Georgia, serif
svg.title: Unfused vs. fused elementwise kernels
svg.desc: Three elementwise ops — RMSNorm, RoPE, residual add — run on an activation tensor of N bytes. Unfused, each op is its own kernel: read N bytes from HBM, write N bytes back, three times over, for six HBM crossings and 6N bytes moved. Fused into one kernel, the intermediate values stay in registers and SRAM the whole time: one read of N bytes, one write of N bytes, two crossings and 2N bytes moved for the identical result.
svg.text: Fusion: stop round-tripping to HBM between tiny ops
Unfused: three kernels, six HBM crossings, 6N bytes
